criteria.criterion: every price is an exact integer in the smallest currency unit
criteria.name: B56-1

criteria.criterion: collapse = lines named - distinct values, and it splits into the two steps
criteria.detail: asi_monument_admission: 3 lines -> 2 values, collapse 1; mta_reduced_fare: 3 lines -> 1 values, collapse 2
criteria.name: B56-2

criteria.criterion: the eligibility step and the pricing step are recorded separately
criteria.detail: asi_monument_admission: 0 at eligibility, 1 at pricing; mta_reduced_fare: 1 at eligibility, 1 at pricing
criteria.name: B56-3

criteria.criterion: every carrier names its instrument and its retrieval
criteria.name: B56-4

criteria.criterion: rival: a seller that has paid to sort gives each sorted block its own price, so distinct values == blocks named
criteria.detail: the rival's point prediction fails where it was read; 0 of 3 read operators hit it. mbta_boston 11 blocks -> 3 values; mta_maryland 4 blocks -> 2 values; mta_new_york 4 blocks -> 2 values
criteria.name: B56-5

criteria.criterion: the same pair of segments, drawn and credentialed by two operators under the same federal condition, gets the same verdict
criteria.detail: the same pair is judged two different ways: mbta_boston merged, mta_maryland priced apart. nominal contradicting pairs 3, independent 1
criteria.name: B56-6

rival_arm.rival: third-degree price discrimination: a seller that has paid to sort and has blocked resale prices each segment by its own elasticity, so two segments share a price only when their elasticities are equal, and elasticity is a property of the rider, not of the operator

mbta_boston.student_line: some middle and high school students, at schools enrolled in the MBTA Student Pass Program (S-Card, M7)
mbta_boston.via: the page's sentence that all reduced fare prices are the same; the student amount is not printed as a separate cell

mta_maryland.student_line: students aged 13 to 21 at participating private, parochial, or Baltimore County public schools, with an MTA Student Transit ID
mta_maryland.via: the fare table prints Student as its own column: full 200, senior/disability 100, student 150

same_pair_two_operators.pair: middle/high school student  vs  65 or over

third_party_payer_excluded.mta_maryland: Baltimore City Public Schools middle and high school students ride free; children 12 and under ride free with no credential at all. Neither is the operator's own price.
